content: Yoosefa kochaafe, Minaase na7aa Makira na7aa Galada kochaa halaqati Musekonne Isra7eele halaqatako yidi
“Nu godaw, Isra7eele asaas laata biitta saaman shaakada immana mela Goday nena kiittis; qassi nu ishaa Selophaada laata iya macca naytas immana mela nena kiittis.
Enti hara koche gidida Isra7eele asi geliko enta laatay nu aawata laatape eketidi enta ekiya zerethas guzhetees. Hessa gisho, nuus saaman imetida laatay guuxees.
Isra7eele asaas Ishatamantho Laytha bonchiya ba7aaley gakiya wode enta laatay enta ekida asaa kochaas guzhetees; hessa gidiko enta laatay nu aawata kochaa laatape eketana” yaagidosona.
Hessa gisho, Musey Godaape ekida kiitaa Isra7eele asaas haysada yaagidi odis; “Yoosefa kochay gidaysi like.
Goday Selophaada macca naytabaa kiittidaysi haysa; enti bantaw dosida azina gelanaw danda7oosona, shin enta kochaafe gidanaw koshshees.
Isra7eele asaa laatay issi kochaafe hara kochaas aadhofo; Isra7eele asay banta kochaa laata biitta minthidi naago.
Isra7eele asa giddon laata biitta ekida maccasi oonika ba aawa koche gidida azina gelanaw koshshees. Hessada oothiko enta kochaa laatay enta kushen gam7ees.
Yaatiko, laatay issi kochaafe hara kochaako aadhenna. Issi issi kochay ba laata biitta oykida mela daana” yaagis.
Yaatin, Selophaada macca nayti Goday Muse kiitidaysada oothidosona.
Selophaada macca nayti, Mahilo, Tirxo, Hoglo, Milkonne No7o geeteteysati banta aawa ishata nayta gelidosona.
Enti Yoosefa na7aa Minaase nayta kochaafe azina gelidosona; enta laatay enta aawa kochaas gidis.
Iyaarkofe hefinthan, Yordaanose shaafa matan, de7iya Moo7abe Denban Muse baggara, Goday Isra7eele asaas kiitida higgetinne wogati haysata.
